name: Substrate Exposure
definition: This concept measures the proportion of the underlying substrate surface that is visible and uncovered by deposited features or structures.

name: Surface Planarity
definition: This concept measures the degree to which a surface is flat and free from undulations, curvature, or significant topographic variations.

name: Feature Aspect Ratio
definition: The ratio of the dominant vertical dimension (height) to the dominant horizontal dimension (width or diameter) of individual structural features.

name: Feature Taper
definition: The degree to which the width of a feature changes along its vertical axis, from base to top.

name: Feature Form Uniformity
definition: The degree to which individual features exhibit consistent shape, surface morphology, and adherence to a regular, uniform form across the micrograph.

name: Feature Dimensionality
definition: This concept quantifies the apparent dimensionality of the primary structural elements, ranging from point-like (0D) to linear (1D), planar (2D), or volumetric (3D) features.

name: Feature Interpenetration
definition: This concept measures the degree to which distinct features or phases are intertwined and occupy the same spatial regions, rather than existing as separate, discrete entities.

name: Feature Brightness Contrast
definition: This concept quantifies the difference in brightness (intensity) between the features and the surrounding background in the SEM image.

name: Feature Surface Texture
definition: The presence and prominence of fine-scale patterns, irregularities, or striations on the visible surfaces of features.

name: Feature Cross-Sectional Uniformity
definition: The degree to which the cross-sectional shape of individual features remains consistent along their length or across multiple instances.

name: Feature Tip Morphology
definition: The characteristic shape and sharpness of the terminal ends of elongated or protruding features.

name: Substrate Particle Coverage
definition: The extent to which the underlying substrate surface is covered by discrete particles or granular material.

name: Image Focus Uniformity
definition: The consistency of sharpness and clarity across the visible depth or plane of the micrograph.

name: Feature Relief Height
definition: The perceived vertical height or protrusion of features from the substrate or surrounding surface.

name: Surface Granularity
definition: The degree to which a surface is composed of distinct, fine-scale particulate or granular elements.

name: Feature Directionality
definition: The extent to which features in the image exhibit a clear, dominant, and consistent orientation or flow.

name: Feature Shape Uniformity and Definition
definition: The consistency and distinctness of the two-dimensional shape and proportions of discrete features.

name: Feature Branching Complexity
definition: The degree to which primary features exhibit secondary or tertiary extensions, creating a tree-like or dendritic structure.

name: Feature Interconnection Density
definition: The extent to which individual fibrous or elongated features are physically linked or interwoven to form a continuous network.

name: Image Sharpness
definition: The overall degree to which features in the micrograph are well-defined and in clear focus.
